text: International Economics and Trade is a discipline that focuses on global economic exchanges, cross-border trade operations and international economic relations, aiming to cultivate professional talents with a solid foundation in economic theory, practical skills in international trade and the ability to operate cross-border business. This major integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as economics, international trade, international finance, and international law, emphasizing the combination of theory and practice. It aims to cultivate students' practical abilities in scenarios such as import and export business, international market analysis, and cross-border investment, in order to adapt to the international business environment under the background of economic globalization.
